# Getting Help

- **Bug reports & feature requests:** open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ebrindley/pi-sandbox-guard/issues).
- **Questions about setup or behavior:** also an [issue](https://github.com/ebrindley/pi-sandbox-guard/issues) — this
  project does not use Discussions, so there is one channel to check.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** open a
  [private security advisory](https://github.com/ebrindley/pi-sandbox-guard/security/advisories/new),
  not a public issue.
  See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Pull requests:** not accepted; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Before filing, worth a look:

- [KNOWN_ANALYZER_GAPS.md](../KNOWN_ANALYZER_GAPS.md) — deliberate, documented
  gaps in the bash analyzer. If you found one of these, it is known.
- [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) — what this tool does and does **not** protect.
  Network egress, credential confidentiality, and writes inside your own project
  are explicitly out of scope.

This project is maintained by a single author for their own use and shared as-is
under MIT. Responses are best-effort and may take several days.
